text:
Sam: Hi, I'm hitting a weird Notion issue. I can view the 'Team Retrospective' org template but when I click Duplicate, it doesn't let me choose our 'Platform' space — only personal workspace. I thought templates auto-duplicate into the org.
Devin (DevEx): Hey Sam, welcome! That happens when your account isn't fully associated with the Redwood SSO workspace (common with alias emails). What email did you sign up with?
Sam: sam+hire1@gmail.com (I used the invite link). I also don't see the Templates page under /docs -> Platform.
Marta: If you used an external email it might not have been attached to your org profile. Check Account -> Settings -> Workspaces in Notion and confirm 'Redwood' is selected.
Sam: Not seeing Redwood listed. The invite email I got looks like it's to sam@redwood.internal — I'm guessing my Google login didn't link.
Devin (DevEx): Ok send me the invite email header or just DM me the address. In the meantime, you can ask Docs-bot to provision a temporary Editor on the Platform space so you can duplicate templates. Use: `@docs-bot grant sam+hire1@gmail.com editor platform --temp 6h` in #devex.
Sam: I don't see Docs-bot in my DM list; should I ping here?
Marta: Yes, ping in #devex so approvals are visible. Also file a quick ticket at https://redwood.example.com/docs-access (choose 'Editor', target 'Platform') — that creates an approval trail.
Sam: Ok doing both. `@docs-bot grant sam+hire1@gmail.com editor platform --temp 6h` Template: https://notion.so/redwood/Team-Retrospective-Template
Docs-bot: Request received for sam+hire1@gmail.com. Approval required by Platform space admin. Audit log created.
PeopleOps: Approved for temp access given onboarding need. Docs-bot: Granted Editor (6h) for sam+hire1@gmail.com on 'Platform'. :white_check_mark:
Sam: I accepted and can now duplicate. Thanks!! Quick follow-up: where do we keep the naming conventions for retrospective pages?
Devin (DevEx): Standards are under /docs -> Standards -> Page Conventions -> Retrospectives. Short rule: `Retrospective-<team>-YYYY-MM-DD` and add the sprint tag and owner.
Sam: Sweet. One more thing: is there a list of templates per space? I want to see all Platform templates in one place.
Marta: Yes, open /docs -> Platform -> Templates and you can favorite the page. If you still can't see it after access, clear your Notion cache or sign out/in.
Sam: Favorited and exported a copy into the Platform space. All set. Appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
Devin (DevEx): Pro tip: if duplication still fails, create a new page from the 'Template button' block in the Templates page (works around duplication permission quirks).
Sam: Noted — thanks everyone! :smile:
